description: This file contains utility functions for integrating Google's reCAPTCHA into the SuiteCRM application, including retrieving settings, verifying responses, and rendering CAPTCHA widgets.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used to fetch CAPTCHA templates.

classes.name: SuiteLogger
classes.description: Logging utility class used for error, warning, and info logging.

methods.name: getRecaptchaSettings
methods.description: Fetches reCAPTCHA-related settings from the Administration bean.

methods.name: getRecaptchaSiteKey
methods.description: Retrieves the public site key for reCAPTCHA from settings.

methods.name: getRecaptchaChallengeField
methods.description: Retrieves the reCAPTCHA challenge field from request parameters.

methods.name: getRecaptchaPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key for reCAPTCHA from settings.

methods.name: getRecaptchaEnabled
methods.description: Checks if reCAPTCHA is enabled based on settings.

methods.name: isRecaptchaEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if reCAPTCHA is enabled ('1' in settings).

methods.name: getRecapthaResponse
methods.description: Gets the user's reCAPTCHA response from request parameters.

methods.name: getRemoteIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the user's remote IP address from server variables.

methods.name: verifyRecapthaResponse
methods.description: Verifies the reCAPTCHA response with Google's API using the ReCaptcha object.

methods.name: isRecapthaResponseVerified
methods.description: Checks if the reCAPTCHA verification succeeded.

methods.name: getRecaptchaErrors
methods.description: Formats and returns any errors from the reCAPTCHA verification response.

methods.name: displayRecaptchaValidation
methods.description: Performs reCAPTCHA validation and logging, returning success or error messages.

methods.name: displayRecaptcha
methods.description: Renders the reCAPTCHA widget or disabled message depending on settings.
